clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, compliance review. Provider may require content deletion/modification or conduct correction, report suspected violations, and restrict, suspend, or terminate services or restrict/freeze the account.
clauses.condition_explanation: Detection may arise from provider review or information from relevant authorities or rights-holder complaints. The listed actions are discretionary enforcement options.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, compliance-review consequences. User bears the stated consequences and compensates provider or third parties for losses caused by user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The provider takes measures described in the preceding compliance-review paragraph; compensation applies when user conduct causes provider or third-party losses.

obligation_items.content: Compensate the provider or a third party for losses caused by the user's conduct.
obligation_items.object: provider or third-party losses caused by user conduct
obligation_items.trigger: User conduct causes a loss to the provider or a third party.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, provider reservation to modify or discontinue services. Notice is qualified as something the provider will endeavor to give.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed reasons are alternatives. Notice may be by website announcement, internal notice, email, or text message and is promised only where possible.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, generated synthetic content. Provider says it will add legally required explicit and implicit labels. User's labeling duty applies when the user requests content without an explicit label; no user duty to add an implicit label is stated.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger is the user's request for generated synthetic content without an explicit label. Required labels and lawful use depend on applicable laws and rules.

obligation_items.content: Add the labels required by applicable laws and rules to generated synthetic content supplied without an explicit label, and use it lawfully and in accordance with applicable rules.
obligation_items.object: generated synthetic content supplied without an explicit label
obligation_items.trigger: User requests generated synthetic content without an explicit label; labeling and use requirements are those applicable under law and relevant rules.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, user business data processed through provider services. Agreement acknowledges the user's complete ownership; this is not a grant to the provider to use the data.
clauses.condition_explanation: User business data includes data processed, stored, uploaded, downloaded, distributed, or otherwise handled through the services.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, user business data. User bears consequences and responsibility arising from data content that violates law, departmental rules, or national policy.
clauses.condition_explanation: The provider advises careful assessment of data source and content legality; the user is expressly responsible for source and content and resulting violations.

obligation_items.content: Take responsibility for the source and content of user business data and for consequences and liability caused by content that violates applicable laws, departmental rules, or national policy.
obligation_items.trigger: User business data is provided or processed; violation-related consequences arise if its content contravenes the specified requirements.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, user business data. Provider may handle data to execute service requests; unauthorized use or disclosure is barred. Exceptions cover legally required cooperation with a competent authority's lawful query or retrieval, or separate agreement by the parties.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition does not bar executing the user's service requirements. The stated authority and separate-agreement exceptions are alternatives.

obligation_items.content: Do not use or disclose user business data without authorization, except to execute the user's service requirements or under a stated exception.
obligation_items.trigger: Provider handles user business data; exceptions are service-request execution, legally required cooperation with a lawful authority query or retrieval, or separate agreement of the parties.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, user business data: user may delete or change its data. If the user releases the service or deletes data, provider will delete online data and, according to the user's instruction, cease retaining it.
clauses.condition_explanation: The provider deletion undertaking is triggered by the user's release of the service or deletion of data. The clause cautions the user to act carefully but states no independently checkable precaution.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, user business data. After expiry, early termination, or user arrears, provider retains data only for the applicable buffer period and deletes all data and copies afterward, except as law, competent-authority requirements, or separate agreement provide otherwise. Buffer-period duration is incorporated from applicable service-specific terms, product documentation, or service description.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger events are alternatives. Deletion follows expiry of the applicable buffer period and is subject to the stated exceptions; the duration is not supplied here.

obligation_items.content: After the applicable buffer period, delete all user business data, including cached and backup copies, and retain none of it.
obligation_items.object: all user business data, including cached and backup copies
obligation_items.trigger: Service term expires, service terminates early, or user has unpaid fees, and the applicable buffer period has expired; except where law, competent-authority requirements, or a separate agreement provide otherwise.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, deleted user business data. Express absence of a continuing duty, not an affirmative prohibition on voluntary retention, export, or return.
clauses.condition_explanation: The clause states no obligation to retain, export, or return data after deletion; it creates no behavioral restriction or permission.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, user business data stored in a data center selected by the user. Storage location depends on agreement; provider undertakes to observe its security commitment and protect data under applicable law.
clauses.condition_explanation: The provider's storage and protection undertaking applies where the parties agree on storage in the selected data center.

obligation_items.content: Store user business data in the data center selected by the user and protect it in accordance with the provider's security commitment and applicable law.
obligation_items.object: user business data stored in the selected data center
obligation_items.trigger: The parties agree on storage in the user-selected data center.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, cross-region operations transferring cloud business data to a selected region or product deployment region. User bears legal consequences and must compensate provider and affiliates for resulting losses if assurances are not observed.
clauses.condition_explanation: For all cross-region operations, user must have authority, protect data, comply with law, and exclude restricted or prohibited content. For potentially cross-border transfers, user should consult legal or compliance professionals beforehand and ensure applicable requirements, such as consent, contract filing, or security assessment where required.

obligation_items.content: Ensure authority to dispose of transferred data, implement sufficient data-security protections, ensure the transfer complies with applicable law, and exclude content whose transfer or disclosure is restricted or prohibited by applicable law.
obligation_items.object: cloud business data transferred in a cross-region operation
obligation_items.trigger: User carries out a cross-region data operation.

obligation_items.content: Before a potentially cross-border transfer, consult legal or compliance professionals and ensure compliance with applicable cross-border requirements, including obtaining required data-subject authorization, completing required contract signing and filing, and completing any required security assessment.
obligation_items.object: cloud business data potentially transferred across borders
obligation_items.trigger: User's cross-region operation may cause a cross-border transfer; listed legal measures apply when required.

obligation_items.content: Compensate the provider and its affiliates for losses resulting from the user's noncompliant cross-region operation.
obligation_items.object: losses suffered by provider or its affiliates from noncompliant cross-region transfer
obligation_items.trigger: User carries out a cross-region operation without complying with the stated assurances and thereby causes provider or affiliate loss.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, account-information definition, particularized in lines 329–331. Definition alone creates no permission or duty.
clauses.condition_explanation: Account information includes submitted personal and company details and provider records such as bills, purchase history, consultations, fault reports, and troubleshooting records.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, enumeration of account information. Descriptive context for the operative information-use provision at lines 332–336; not itself a grant or duty.
clauses.condition_explanation: Categories include company and identity details, contact and payment information, and records of bills, purchases, consultations, fault reports, and troubleshooting.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, user account information. Purpose limitation governs uses specified in the following subparagraphs; exceptions are separate agreement or lawful authority query/retrieval.
clauses.condition_explanation: The exceptions are alternatives. Permitted service-related uses are specified at lines 334 and 336.

obligation_items.content: Do not use user account information for purposes other than providing or improving services, except where the parties separately agree or a relevant authority lawfully queries or retrieves it.
obligation_items.trigger: Provider collects user account information; separate agreement or lawful authority query/retrieval is an exception.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, account information: specified service-provision purpose within the purpose limitation at line 332.
clauses.condition_explanation: Permitted purpose is providing the services the user uses and maintaining or improving them; line 332 exceptions also apply.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, account information: recommendation purpose remains subject to line 332 and applicable law.
clauses.condition_explanation: Recommendations may include product and service information; applicable legal requirements govern this use.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, user support data. Monitoring and recording is for the stated purposes; support data excludes user business data and account information.
clauses.condition_explanation: Purposes are timely response to help requests, overall cloud-platform security, and service improvement. This clause does not authorize use of business data or account information as support data.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, service activation through the account, using prepaid or postpaid activation and credentials sent by provider.
clauses.condition_explanation: The described access method is receipt of login/use keys or passwords after activation; service term runs from activation.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, possible charges for unjustified early unsubscription. Applicable methods and amounts are determined by the official website display or relevant order and are not provided here.
clauses.condition_explanation: Trigger is unjustified user unsubscription before expiry; the listed remedies are alternatives.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement incorporates the applicable order for charges, resource-use methods, and treatment of unused resources at expiry; its substantive terms are absent.
clauses.condition_explanation: The paragraph points to the relevant product or service order rather than stating its substantive terms.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, changes or cessation. General changes require best-efforts prior notice; termination requires at least 30 days' notice and return of paid, unconsumed fees to the user's account.
clauses.condition_explanation: Listed circumstances are alternatives. The 30-day minimum and refund apply specifically when the provider terminates the service.

obligation_items.content: Give advance notice by one or more stated channels to the best of its efforts before changing the service or ceasing it.
obligation_items.trigger: Provider changes or ceases a service for a stated technology, service-system, business-strategy, or major technology/policy reason.

obligation_items.content: Give at least 30 days' advance notice and return paid but unconsumed service fees to the user's account.
obligation_items.object: terminated service and paid but unconsumed service fees
obligation_items.trigger: Provider terminates provision of the service.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, early termination by mutual agreement.
clauses.condition_explanation: The service term ends early if both parties agree.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, early termination for serious user breach; provider may terminate and clear all user data.
clauses.condition_explanation: Serious breach includes, but is not limited to, serious violation of applicable law or a promise under the agreement.

clauses.scope_note: User service agreement, response to network-security incidents. Provider may suspend or terminate services or take other necessary protective measures.
clauses.condition_explanation: Trigger includes attacks or other network-security harms affecting provider or other Baidu networks/servers, or impairing specified network connectivity. The security threat examples include viruses, network intrusion, attacks, and DDoS.

coverage_notes: Applicable buffer-period duration depends on service-specific terms, product documentation, or service descriptions not supplied.
Order-specific charging, resource-use, and unused-resource terms are not supplied. Applicable legal requirements for labeling and cross-border data transfers may also depend on external materials.

Captures the specified service-provision, maintenance, and improvement purpose.
Captures recommendations of potentially interesting content, including product/service information, subject to law.
